notes.title: Major Patch 2.0
notes.content:
Due to very helpful user suggestions, I have turned up the difficulty of the game a lot.
The game is now much more challenging, and the first 5 missions are less of tutorial missions, and more of actual skill-training missions.

There is a list of commands you must use to achieve the hacking results you want.

Thank you for the suggestion, friends.

I hope you enjoy!
